default_policy: discover on demand; no silent install; official/reviewed source pins; least privilege; target verification before mutations; evidence for writes

roblox-studio.notes: Primary live Roblox bridge. Verify nonproduction place/universe and writer ownership before mutation.

graphify.provider: Graphify local repository knowledge graph CLI; MCP transport optional
graphify.default_mode: code-only local extraction; update after pull/merge; query before broad repo scans
graphify.notes: Repository intelligence/memory augmentation, not authority. Default install omits the MCP extra because the bootstrap uses the CLI directly, reducing dependencies and tool context. Code-only mapping is local and deterministic; Graphify MCP transport and semantic docs/media extraction are opt-in capabilities.

blender.notes: Priority path for Blender-suitable 3D assets. High-privilege authoring surface: it can execute Python inside Blender. Bootstrap default is localhost + safe mode + telemetry disabled. Verify target blend/scene/collection and export path, then use measured gates and round-trip validation. Disabling safe mode or enabling network/paid asset providers requires an explicit human decision.

external_capability_note: BloxMaps is a pinned external production capability, not an MCP. See 08_TOOLCHAIN/BLOXMAPS_INTEGRATION.json.
